meta.title: wp-html-converter-test base site
meta.description: A fresh throwaway WordPress for one converter run. The only base step turns off the editor's welcome guide so screenshots show the content. Tool steps are appended from harness/tools/<tool>.mjs.
meta.author: wp-html-converter-test

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
$slugs = array( 'index' => 'home', 'about' => 'about', 'services' => 'services', 'contact' => 'contact' );
$out = array();
foreach ( array( 'index', 'about', 'services', 'contact' ) as $page ) {
  $content = '';
  $id = wp_insert_post( array(
    'post_type'    => 'page',
    'post_status'  => 'publish',
    'post_title'   => ucfirst( $page === 'index' ? 'home' : $page ),
    'post_name'    => $slugs[ $page ],
    'post_content' => $content,
  ), true );
  $out[ $page ] = is_wp_error( $id )
    ? array( 'error' => $id->get_error_message() )
    : array( 'id' => $id, 'url' => get_permalink( $id ), 'stored_content' => get_post_field( 'post_content', $id, 'raw' ) );
  if ( 'index' === $page && ! is_wp_error( $id ) ) {
    update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
    update_option( 'page_on_front', $id );
  }
}
file_put_contents( '/harness/out/pages.json', wp_json_encode( $out, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT ) );
